failure_reason: Registration is not valid. Failed checks: inlier_spatial_spread. Diagnostics were written for inspection; the warp and overlay carry a warning banner and must not be treated as a valid alignment.

implementation.model: LoFTR (detector-free local feature matching with transformers)
implementation.weights_rationale: Trained on MegaDepth (outdoor landmark photo collections with wide viewpoint and illumination variation). The 'indoor' alternative is ScanNet and is inappropriate for outdoor architecture.

parameters.preprocessing: Greyscale conversion and aspect-preserving resize with zero padding to a multiple of 8. No CLAHE, no ROI crop, no contrast manipulation -- LoFTR was trained on ordinary photographs and the point of this experiment is to isolate the learned-matching variable.

validity_gates.note: Identical to the sift_improved thresholds, plus an overlap floor, so LoFTR is held to exactly the same standard.

checks.name: sufficient_filtered_matches
checks.rationale: A homography needs 4 points; near that count RANSAC has no consensus to measure and always 'succeeds'.

checks.name: homography_well_conditioned
checks.rationale: Scale-invariant degeneracy test; cond(cH) == cond(H). The baseline's absolute |det(H)| test was scale-dependent and passed a homography with cond = 1.79e9.

checks.name: sufficient_inliers
checks.rationale: Absolute floor on the size of the consensus set.

checks.name: sufficient_inlier_ratio
checks.rationale: If under a quarter of filtered matches agree, the consensus set is likely a coincidental cluster.

checks.name: inlier_spatial_spread
checks.rationale: Inliers confined to a small region give a homography that is locally consistent and globally unconstrained.

checks.name: warped_frame_sane
checks.rationale: A folded or collapsed quadrilateral is the signature of a degenerate homography that still produces an image.

checks.name: no_vanishing_line_crossing
checks.threshold: all four corner w-values share a sign
checks.rationale: A sign flip means the vanishing line passes through the image and part of the source is mapped through infinity. This caused the radial smear in both classical experiments.

checks.name: sufficient_overlap
checks.rationale: Floor only. A degenerate homography covered 98% of the frame in the baseline, so a high overlap fraction proves nothing.

notes: This experiment tests the CORRESPONDENCE question. Correspondence success and homography success are separate questions and are reported separately.
Reprojection error over inliers is bounded above by the RANSAC threshold by construction and is never used as a validity gate.
RANSAC threshold is in LoFTR INFERENCE pixels, whose resolution differs from the SIFT experiments' working images; account for that when comparing absolute pixel errors.
Geometric registration is a prerequisite for change analysis. It is not evidence of structural change, damage or deterioration.

correspondences.threshold_note: The decision threshold was fixed at 0.5 before the run. Counts at other thresholds are reported for transparency only and were not used to select a result.

geometric_error.definition: Forward reprojection error ||project(H, x_archival) - x_modern||_2, in modern INFERENCE pixels.
geometric_error.caveat: Bounded above by the RANSAC threshold over inliers by construction. Recorded, never gated.

photometric_check.definition: Pearson correlation of greyscale intensity over the valid warp overlap. The only reported signal not derived from the correspondences RANSAC used.
